entries.name: Bathurst
infrastructureProjectTexts: Bathurst Hospital Redevelopment — $200 million, construction underway (source: NSW Health Infrastructure)

entries.name: Orange
infrastructureProjectTexts: Orange Health Service palliative care redevelopment — part of the $93 million World Class End of Life Care Program, targeted 2026 (source: NSW Health Infrastructure)

entries.name: Dubbo
infrastructureProjectTexts: Dubbo Base Hospital Redevelopment — $150 million, Stages 1–4 (source: NSW Health Infrastructure)

entries.name: Wagga Wagga
infrastructureProjectTexts: Riverina Redevelopment Program (RAAF Base Wagga & Blamey Barracks Kapooka) — $800 million Defence infrastructure upgrade, construction from mid-2025, completion by mid-2033 (source: Department of Defence)

entries.name: Tamworth
infrastructureProjectTexts: Tamworth Hospital Nioka Palliative Care Unit expansion — doubling capacity from 6 to 12 beds, part of the $93 million World Class End of Life Care Program, expected early 2027 (source: NSW Health Infrastructure)

entries.name: Armidale
infrastructureProjectTexts: Armidale Hospital redevelopment — completed, new Emergency, ICU, surgical and medical inpatient units (source: Health Infrastructure NSW)

entries.name: Albury
infrastructureProjectTexts: Albury Wodonga Regional Hospital — business case approved January 2025, early works underway (source: NSW Government / Health Infrastructure NSW)

entries.name: Coffs Harbour
infrastructureProjectTexts: Coffs Harbour Bypass (Pacific Highway) — $2.20 billion, opening to traffic expected late 2026, full completion late 2027 (source: Transport for NSW)

entries.name: Lismore
infrastructureProjectTexts: Lismore Base Hospital Redevelopment — $312 million, two new hospital towers and expanded emergency department (source: NSW Health Infrastructure)

entries.name: Tweed Heads
infrastructureProjectTexts: Tweed Valley Hospital — new $723.3 million hospital at Cudgen, opened to patients 14 May 2024 (source: NSW Health)

entries.name: Goulburn
infrastructureProjectTexts: Goulburn Hospital and Health Service Redevelopment — $165 million, completed June 2024 (source: NSW Health)

entries.name: Griffith
infrastructureProjectTexts: Griffith Base Hospital Redevelopment — $250 million, on track for completion 2025 (source: NSW Government)

entries.name: Queanbeyan
infrastructureProjectTexts: Monaro Highway safety upgrade — approx. $20 million, expected completion mid-2026 (source: Transport for NSW)

entries.name: Mudgee
infrastructureProjectTexts: Mudgee Hospital Redevelopment — $70.7 million, completed (source: NSW Health Infrastructure)

entries.name: Maitland
infrastructureProjectTexts: New Maitland Hospital — $470 million redevelopment, officially opened June 2025 (source: NSW Health Infrastructure)

entries.name: Cessnock
infrastructureProjectTexts: Cessnock Hospital Redevelopment — $138 million, under construction (source: NSW Government)

entries.name: Cowra
infrastructureProjectTexts: Cowra Hospital Redevelopment — $110.2 million (source: NSW Health Infrastructure)

entries.name: Port Macquarie
infrastructureProjectTexts: Port Macquarie Base Hospital upgrade — $265 million redevelopment including a new four-storey inpatient building and ED expansion (source: NSW Government)

entries.name: Parramatta
infrastructureProjectTexts: Sydney Metro West — Parramatta station, tunnelling complete 2026, line targeted to open 2032 (source: Sydney Metro / NSW Government)

entries.name: Liverpool
infrastructureProjectTexts: Liverpool Health and Academic Precinct — $830 million Liverpool Hospital redevelopment, Stage 2 (Integrated Services Building, expanded Emergency Department) under construction (source: NSW Government / Health Infrastructure)

entries.name: Penrith
infrastructureProjectTexts: Sydney Metro — Western Sydney Airport Line (St Marys–Orchard Hills–Luddenham–Bradfield–Airport Terminal–Airport Business Park), targeted to open 2027; Orchard Hills station near Penrith under construction (source: Sydney Metro / NSW Government)

entries.name: Mount Druitt
infrastructureProjectTexts: Sydney Metro — Western Sydney Airport Line, St Marys station (interchange with T1 line) under construction, targeted to open 2027; new bus network linking Mount Druitt to the airport line (source: Sydney Metro / NSW Government)

entries.name: Bankstown
infrastructureProjectTexts: Sydney Metro City & Southwest — conversion of the T3 Bankstown Line to metro standard; Bankstown Station becoming the 'central station of the southwest,' new Southwest Metro targeted to open second half of 2026 (source: Sydney Metro / NSW Government)

entries.name: St Marys
infrastructureProjectTexts: Sydney Metro — Western Sydney Airport Line — St Marys becomes a major interchange connecting the new metro to the existing suburban rail network; target opening April 2027 (source: NSW Government / Sydney Metro)
